purpose: Provide a source-controlled, page-aware reader digest for the private-actor complaint lane, DP 1901/2026, DP 1956/2026 and the daily-reference-24 judicial filing record while preserving procedural-identity uncertainty and actor-specific attribution.

continuity_governance.binding_rule: This reader-layer dataset is subordinate to the canonical continuity graph for procedural identity and bridge status. A reader-facing label or source filename cannot upgrade an unverified bridge.

DP1901-C21.do_not_infer: The 25-Jun private-actor complaint is documented and its 9-Jul amplification was physically tendered under DP1901/Plaza6. The 25-Jun Ref21 filing and 9-Jul mapping contemporaneously corroborate Gil's statement that Ref21 became DP1901. Do not state that the court's electronic initiating/reparto event or later Ref24 association mechanism is independently certified; those authority-controlled records remain required.

DP1956-C22.do_not_infer: Do not state that daily reference 22 became DP 1956/2026 without a source-certified intake/reparto bridge.

C24-JUDGE.do_not_infer: Daily reference 24 is not itself a NIG or DP. Its separate 18-Jun judge filing and 25-Jun 13-page dependent supplement are documented, but the 14-Sep DP1901 order does not prove that daily reference 24 generated, was joined to or was reassigned into DP1901.

same_date_safeguard.rule: The two potentially distinct 25 June 2026 document objects remain separate unless a primary source proves identity.

supervening_event_20260918.rule: June/July source closure proves separate daily-reference-21 and daily-reference-24 filings and a 9-Jul private-actor tender under DP1901/Plaza6. The signed 12-Jul DIP2 link and 14-Sep prevaricación treatment leave the collision direction uncertified; do not resolve it without the initiating/reparto/index/ingestion record.

global_boundary: The three tracks are evidentially interconnected but procedurally separate.
Shared evidence does not transfer knowledge, intent, causation, guilt or liability.
A complaint proves that an allegation was made; it does not prove the allegation.
Private originals, signatures, personal identifiers, private addresses, emails, verification codes and privileged material are not published here.
Public digitisation means complete text-layer processing, structured indexing and public-safe presentation; it does not mean publication of the raw private pleading.
